title: Florida Keys Watersports
specs: Boats can be taken to the World Famous Islamorada sandbar less than 1 mile from marina
Must be at least 18 years old to rent a jet ski, 14 years old to operate, passengers any age
Combined weight limit 400 pounds per jet ski for up to two riders
Those born on or after Jan 1, 1988 may require Florida Boating Permit to drive jet ski; temporary permits issued on site
Boat rental security deposit $1000 per vessel, cash or credit card authorization
Jet ski security deposit $300 per jet ski, cash or credit card authorization
Jet skis allow 1 or 2 riders with no passenger fee; max 400 pounds combined weight
Boat capacities range from 3 to 10 passengers depending on boat model

blurb: Guests can rent jet skis and boats for fishing, snorkeling, island hopping, and cruising. Jet ski rentals include guided tours and snorkeling gear options. Boats range from 13 to 24 feet with capacities from 3 to 10 passengers and include various amenities.
extraNote: Rates may change based on season and holidays without notice · No refunds for any reason on multiple day boat rentals; remaining credit expires after term · Boat rentals must be returned by 6:00 PM daily; no overnight rentals allowed · Cancellation: outside 72 hours changes permitted; inside 72 hours no refunds except for un-rentable weather conditions · Cash deposits returned at end of rental; credit card holds released in 1-3 business days · Marina in Islamorada, Florida Keys
